CAS — 7631-86-9. Pharmacopoeias. In USNF. USNF 26 (Purified Siliceous Earth). A form of silicon dioxide consisting of frustules and fragments of diatoms purified by cal- cining. A very fine, white, light grey, or pale buff mixture of amorphous powder and lesser amounts of crystalline poly- morphs, including quartz and cristobalite. It is gritty and readily absorbs moisture, and retains about four times its weight of water before becoming fluid. Insoluble in water, in acids, and in dilute solutions of alkali hydroxides.
